# Lua source

Lua 5.5.1 comes from the official Lua repository tag `v5.5.1`.

https://codeload.github.com/lua/lua/tar.gz/refs/tags/v5.5.1

The source archive SHA-256 is `ffed0b0e2987e66b0142491b26c63170ffd2d86e425ff3703799f4933fd91810`.

Only upstream C sources, headers, and README are retained. The MIT license is in `lua-5.5.1/lua.h`. The build compiles Lua directly. Homebrew and a runtime Lua installation are not needed.
